title: Uchrashuv va yig‘ilish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz inglizcha yig‘ilishlarda to‘liq qatnashasiz va ularni boshqarasiz: kun tartibini o‘qib ochish, fikr bildirish va so‘rash, muloyim suhbatni bo‘lish, qarorlarni xulosalash va action items belgilash, hamda yig‘ilish bayoni (minutes) yozish.
homework_uz: Jamoangiz bilan o‘tkazilgan 10 daqiqalik haqiqiy yoki o‘zingiz o‘ylab topgan yig‘ilishning bayoni (minutes) yozing: sana, qatnashchilar, uzrlar, muhokama qilingan masalalar, qabul qilingan qarorlar va action items — har birida kim, nima va qachongacha. Keyin bir hamkasbingiz bilan ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: bayon bir sahifadan oshmasin, har qaror alohida qatorda, har action itemda aniq mas’ul shaxs va muddat bo‘lsin. Keyingi dars: P1-07 Taqdimot (prezentatsiya).

vocab.uz: har masala uchun ajratilgan vaqt chegarasi
yig‘ilishda emas, keyin ikki kishi bo‘lib hal qiling

scenes.title: Yig‘ilishlar: nega ular foydali bo‘lishi mumkin
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda rasmiy elektron xat yozishni o‘rgandik. Bugun yozishdan gapirishga o‘tamiz — uchrashuv va yig‘ilishlar. Yig‘ilish yomon emas, yomon tayyorgarlik yomon: maqsad yo‘q, kun tartibi yo‘q, natija yo‘q. Dars oxirida siz yig‘ilishni ochib, uni boshqarib, qarorlarni xulosalay olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last lesson was formal e-mails. Today we move from writing to speaking — meetings. A meeting is not a waste of time; an unprepared one is. By the end you will open, run and wrap up a meeting, and hold your own in one.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda rasmiy elektron xat o‘rgandik. Bugun yozishdan gapirishga — yig‘ilishlarga o‘tamiz. Yig‘ilish vaqt sarfi emas; yomon tayyorgarlik sarfidir. Dars oxirida siz yig‘ilishni ochib, boshqarib, yakunlay olasiz.

scenes.title: Yig‘ilish turlari: kick-off, status, qaror
scenes.say_native: Uchta keng tarqalgan tur. Kick-off — loyiha boshlanishida, hamma bir xil tushunishi uchun. Status update — har haftalik holat: nima bo‘ldi, nima qoldi, nima xalaqit qilyapti. Decision meeting — bitta muhim qaror qabul qilish uchun, chaqiruvchi bu qarorni yozma taklif qiladi. Yig‘ilish chaqirishdan oldin o‘zingizga ayting: maqsadi nima, kim shart va natijasi nima?
scenes.say: Three meeting types. Kick-off: at project start, everyone aligns. Status update: weekly, what moved and what is blocked. Decision meeting: one important call, with a written proposal sent round in advance. Before calling one, ask: goal, who must attend, what will exist at the end.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta tur. Kick-off — loyiha boshlanishida, hamma bir xil tushunsin. Status update — har haftalik: nima bo‘ldi, nima qoldi, nima to‘siq. Decision meeting — bitta muhim qaror uchun, taklif oldindan yozma yuboriladi. Chaqirishdan oldin: maqsadi nima, kim shart, natijasi nima?

scenes.title: Agenda: yig‘ilishning skeleti

examples.t: Agenda: 1) Budget review 2) Launch date 3) Roles.
examples.uz: Kun tartibi: 1) byudjet 2) ishga tushirish sanasi 3) rollar.

scenes.say_native: Agenda — yig‘ilishning skeleti: masalalar raqamli tartibda, har biriga vaqt chegarasi qo‘yiladi, odatda o‘n daqiqa. Tartib shunday: ochilish, masalalar, oxirida Any Other Business. Agendani yig‘ilishdan kamida bir kun oldin yuboring, shunda qatnashchilar tayyor keladi va qaror tezroq qabul qilinadi.
scenes.say: The agenda is the skeleton: numbered items, each with a time-box — ten minutes is normal. The shape: opening, items, then Any Other Business. Send it a day in advance; informed people decide faster, and the meeting shrinks from an hour to thirty minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Agenda — skelet: raqamlangan masalalar, har biriga vaqt, odatda o‘n daqiqa. Tartib: ochilish, masalalar, oxirida Any Other Business. Kamida bir kun oldin yuboring — tayyor qatnashchilar tez qaror qabul qiladi.

scenes.title: Ochilish: 'Let's make a start'

examples.t: Good morning, all. Let's make a start — first item.

scenes.say_native: Ochilish qirq besh soniya turadi. Salomlang: Good morning, everyone. Minnatdorchilik: Thank you all for coming. Boshlash: Let's make a start yoki Shall we begin? Keyin agendani bir qatorda ayting va birinchi masalani oching. Uzrli bo‘lganlarni qisqa eslating: Apologies for absence from Timur — he is travelling.
scenes.say: The opening takes under a minute. Greet: Good morning, everyone. Thank people for coming. Open: Let's make a start, or Shall we begin? Preview the agenda in one line, name apologies for absence, then open the first item.
scenes.say_uz: Ochilish bir daqiqadan kam. Salomlang: Good morning, everyone. Minnatdorchilik bildiring. Boshlang: Let's make a start. Agendani bir qatorda ayting, kelmaganlarning uzrini eslating, keyin birinchi masalani oching.

scenes.title: Namuna: ochilish va agendani o‘qish
board: Greet → Thanks → Agenda → Apologies → First item
scenes.say_native: Namunani diqqat bilan o‘qing: salom, minnatdorchilik, ochish, agenda xaritasi, uzr va birinchi masala — besh qadam, qirq besh soniya. E’tibor bering: uzr bir jumla va salomlashish ichida, alohida xabar emas. Oxirida birinchi masalaga o‘tish aniq — hamma nima qilishni biladi.
scenes.say: Good morning, everyone. Thank you all for coming. Let's make a start. As you saw on the agenda, we have three items today: the budget review, the launch date and roles. Apologies for absence from Timur — he is travelling. First item: the budget review. Over to Jasur, please.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong, hamma. Kelganingiz uchun rahmat. Boshlaymiz. Agendada ko‘rganingizdek, uchta masala: byudjet ko‘rib chiqish, ishga tushirish sanasi va rollar. Timur kelmagani uchun uzr — yo‘lda. Birinchi masala: byudjet ko‘rib chiqish. So‘zni Jasurga beraman.

scenes.title: Ochilish nutqini ayting
scenes.say_native: Endi ovoz chiqarib mashq qiling. Vaziyat: jamoangiz beshta kishi, ikkita masala — yangi mijozni qo‘shish va juma kungi demonstratsiya. Salomlang, ikki masalani ayting, Dilnozaning kelolmaganini uzr sifatida eslating va birinchi masala bo‘yicha Jasurga so‘z bering. O‘ttiz emas, yigirma soniya — qisqa va aniq.
scenes.say: Practise the opening aloud. Scenario: five colleagues, two items — new client onboarding and Friday's demo. Greet everyone, name the two items, give Dilnoza's apology for absence, and hand the first item to Jasur. Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Ochilishni ovoz chiqarib mashq qiling. Vaziyat: besh hamkasb, ikki masala — yangi mijoz qo‘shish va juma kungi demo. Salomlang, ikki masalani ayting, Dilnozaning uzri borligini eslatib, birinchi masalani Jasurga bering. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ochilish
board: 'Good morning, all. Let's make a start.'
'Two items today: client onboarding, Friday demo.'
'Apologies from Dilnoza — she is on site.'
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob shunday tuziladi: salom va minnatdorchilik, agendani raqamlar bilan ismdan o‘qish, uzr bir jumlada va aniq keyingi so‘z egasi. Javobingiz shundan farq qilsa, qirq besh soniyadan oshib ketgan yoki salomlashmasdan boshlagan bo‘lasiz. Ikkalasini tuzatib, bir bor yana aytib bering.
scenes.say: Good morning, everyone, and thanks for making time. Two items today: client onboarding and Friday's demo. Apologies from Dilnoza — she is on site. First item: client onboarding. Jasur, over to you.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong, hamma, vaqt ajratganingiz uchun rahmat. Ikki masala: mijoz qo‘shish va juma kungi demo. Dilnoza yo‘q — u saytda. Birinchi masala: mijoz qo‘shish. Jasur, so‘z sizniki.

scenes.title: Fikr bildirish: 'From my perspective…'

examples.t: From my perspective, we should cut the scope.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbekda fikr birdan aytiladi — inglizchada avval ramka qo‘yiladi. 'I think' — eng neytral. 'From my perspective' — tajribangizga asoslangan, kuchliroq. 'The way I see it' — bevosita, lekin do‘stona. 'It seems to me that' — eng yumshoq. Kuchliroq ishontirish uchun: 'I strongly believe that…' — kamdan-kam ishlating, aks holda sizni g‘ayur deb bilishadi.
scenes.say: Uzbeks state opinions head-on; English frames them first. 'I think' is neutral. 'From my perspective' grounds it in your experience. 'The way I see it' is direct but friendly. 'It seems to me that' is the softest. Save 'I strongly believe' for moments that truly matter.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbek tilida fikr birdan aytiladi; inglizchada avval ramka qo‘yiladi. 'I think' — neytral. 'From my perspective' — tajribaga tayanadi. 'The way I see it' — bevosita, do‘stona. 'It seems to me that' — eng yumshoq. 'I strongly believe' — juda kam ishlating.

scenes.title: Fikr so‘rash: 'What are your thoughts?'

examples.t: Nilufar, what's your take on the timeline?
examples.uz: Nilufar, sizning fikringiz muddat haqida nima?

scenes.say_native: Fikr so‘rashda ha/yo‘q savollar emas, ochiq savollar ishlating: What are your thoughts on this? How do you see it? Kimningdir fikrini chaqirish uchun ism bilan: Jasur, what do you think? Jim o‘tirganga: Would you like to add anything? Oxirida: Does anyone disagree? — jimlik rozilik deb qabul qilinadi.
scenes.say: Ask open questions, not yes-no ones: What are your thoughts on this? How do you see it? To pull out a quiet voice: Jasur, what do you think? Or simply: Would you like to add anything? Close with: Does anyone disagree? — silence counts as consent.
scenes.say_uz: Ha/yo‘q savol emas, ochiq savol bering: What are your thoughts on this? How do you see it? Jim o‘tirganni chaqiring: Jasur, what do you think? Yoping: Does anyone disagree? — sukunat rozilik sanaladi.

scenes.title: Namuna: fikr almashinuvi
scenes.say_native: Namunada har bir qatnashchi ikki jumladan ortiq gapirmaydi: fikr, sabab, keyingi savolga navbat. Nilufar ochadi, Jasur 'From my perspective' bilan javob beradi, Madina 'The way I see it' bilan qo‘shiladi va Nilufar 'Does anyone disagree?' bilan yopadi. Shu ritmni o‘zingiz ham takrorlang — qisqa navbatlar yig‘ilishni jonlantiradi.
scenes.say: Nilufar: We could launch on the 15th. What are your thoughts? Jasur: From my perspective, the budget is tight — we should cut scope. Madina: The way I see it, cutting scope saves time too. I'd say the 15th works. Nilufar: Good. Does anyone disagree?
scenes.say_uz: Nilufar: O‘n beshinchida ishga tushsak bo‘ladi. Fikringiz? Jasur: Mening nazarimda, byudjet zich — hajmni qisqartirish kerak. Madina: Mening ko‘rinishimcha, hajm qisqartirish vaqt ham tejaydi. Menimcha o‘n beshinchi bo‘ladi. Nilufar: Yaxshi. Kimdir norozimi?

scenes.title: Fikringizni bildiring
scenes.say_native: Endi fikr bildiring. Vaziyat: jamoangiz hajmni qisqartirishni muhokama qilyapti. 'From my perspective' bilan boshlang, bir sabab ayting, bitta raqam qo‘shing — masalan, byudjet yoki kunlar — va oxirida boshqalardan so‘rang: How do you see it? Yigirma besh soniya, ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Give your opinion aloud. Scenario: your team debates cutting scope. Open with 'From my perspective', give one reason, add one number — days or sums — then turn to others: How do you see it? Twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Fikringizni ovoz chiqarib ayting. Vaziyat: jamoa hajmni qisqartirishni muhokama qilyapti. 'From my perspective' bilan boshlang, bir sabab va bir raqam ayting, keyin boshqalardan so‘rang: How do you see it? Yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: namunaviy fikrlar
board: 'From my perspective, cutting scope saves time.'
'It seems to me that six million is enough.'
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar shunday tuziladi: ramka, sabab, raqam va qaytarish savoli. Agar javobingiz faqat 'I think yes' bo‘lsa — sabab yetishmaydi. Agar raqam ham bo‘lsa — sizni professional deb bilishadi. Bir daqiqa ichida yana bir bor ayting, endi 'I strongly believe' bilan kuchliroq versiyasini ham sinab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: From my perspective, cutting scope is the only safe route — we save roughly two weeks and stay inside six million. Madina, how do you see it? If we keep everything, I think we risk the 22nd review. Strong but honest.
scenes.say_uz: Mening nazarimda, hajm qisqartirish eng xavfsiz yo‘l — taxminan ikki hafta yutamiz va olti millionda qolamiz. Madina, sizning fikringiz? Agar hammasini saqlasak, yigirma ikkinchi ko‘rib chiqish xavfli. Kuchli, lekin halol.

scenes.title: Muloyim to‘sib kirish: 'Can I come in here?'

examples.t: Sorry to jump in — just one number.
examples.uz: Uzr, gapingizga topib kirsam — bitta raqam.

scenes.say_native: Suhbatga muloyim kirib borish uchta shartdan iborat: uzr iborasi, bitta aniq sabab va qisqa navbat. 'Sorry to jump in, but' — eng neytral. 'If I may add' — qo‘shimcha uchun. 'Can I come in here?' — savol shaklida, eng muloyim. O‘zbekda 'gapira olamanmi?' deymiz — inglizchada ham xuddi shunday, faqat qisqaroq. Hech qachon gaplashayotgan odamning ustidan gapirmang.
scenes.say: Breaking in politely has three parts: an apology marker, one clear reason and a short turn. 'Sorry to jump in, but…' is neutral. 'If I may add…' adds to a point. 'Can I come in here?' asks permission — the softest. Never talk over someone mid-sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Muloyim kirib borish: uzr belgisi, bitta aniq sabab, qisqa navbat. 'Sorry to jump in, but…' — neytral. 'If I may add…' — qo‘shimcha. 'Can I come in here?' — ruxsat so‘rash, eng muloyim. Hech qachon kimningdir ustidan gapirmang.

scenes.title: Chair qanday to‘sib kirishlarni boshqaradi

examples.t: Let's park the VAT question — offline after this.
examples.uz: VAT savolini keyinga qoldiramiz — yig‘ilishdan keyin hal qilamiz.

scenes.say_native: Moderatorning asboblari: ism bilan chaqirish — Let's hear from Madina; tartib — one at a time, please; mavzuga qaytish — let's park that; vaqt — time-box: two minutes left. Agar ikki odam birdan gapirsa: Jasur, you first, then Madina. Bu qoidalar sovuq emas — ular hammaga teng vaqt beradi va yig‘ilishni yo‘q qilmaydi.
scenes.say: The chair's toolkit: call by name — Let's hear from Madina. Enforce order — one at a time, please. Park side topics — let's park that. Watch the clock — time-box: two minutes left. Two people at once? Jasur, you first, then Madina. Fair time, not coldness.
scenes.say_uz: Moderator asboblari: ism bilan chaqirish — Let's hear from Madina; tartib — One at a time, please; mavzudan chiqsa — let's park that; vaqt — Time-box: two minutes left. Birga gapirsa: Jasur, you first, then Madina. Bu adolat, sovuqlik emas.

scenes.title: Xato: qattiq to‘xtatish
board: ✓ 'If I may — I see it differently.'
✓ 'I'm not sure that's right — could we check?'

examples.t: ✗ Stop!  ✗ That's wrong.  ✓ I see it differently.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbekda bola otasining fikrini to‘xtatishi tabiiy tuyuladi — ingliz muhitida bu hujum deb qabul qilinadi. 'You're wrong' emas — 'I see it differently' yoki 'I'm not sure that's right'. 'Could we check the numbers?' — muammoni odamga emas, raqamga o‘tkazadi. Norozilikni raqam yoki fakt bilan ifoda qiling, his-hayajon bilan emas.
scenes.say: Never open with 'Stop, you're wrong.' That lands as an attack. Use 'If I may — I see it differently.' Or: 'I'm not sure that's right — could we check the numbers?' Move the disagreement onto the facts, off the person.
scenes.say_uz: 'Stop, you're wrong' deb boshlamang — bu hujum bo‘lib qabul qilinadi. 'If I may — I see it differently' deb ayting. Yoki: 'I'm not sure that's right — could we check the numbers?' Tortishuvni odamdan raqamga o‘tkazing.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: Kick-off yig‘ilishi
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash — ilova loyihasi kick-off'i. Nilufar moderator, Jasur backend, Madina dizayn. Uch masala: byudjet, muddat va rollar. Jasur byudjet bo‘yicha muloyim to‘sib kirib tuzatish kiritadi. Diqqat bilan tinglang — keyingi sahifada to‘rt savol bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Nilufar: Morning, everyone. Let's make a start. Three items: budget, timeline, roles. Jasur? Jasur: I think six million won't cover design — seven is safer. Can I come in here? Nilufar: Of course. From my perspective, six — with a review on the 22nd. Madina: I'd say six and review in two weeks. Nilufar: Agreed. Timeline, Madina? Madina: Nine weeks, not eight — the holiday. Nilufar: Agreed — launch 20 May. Actions out tonight. Thanks, everyone.
scenes.say_uz: Nilufar: Xayrli tong. Boshlaymiz. Uch masala: byudjet, muddat, rollar. Jasur? Jasur: Menimcha olti million dizaynga yetmaydi — yetti xavfsizroq. Kirishim mumkinmi? Nilufar: Albatta. Menimcha olti, lekin yigirma ikkinchida ko‘rib chiqamiz. Madina: Menimcha olti va ikki haftada ko‘rib chiqamiz. Nilufar: Kelishdik. Muddat, Madina? Madina: To‘qqiz hafta, sakkiz emas — bayram bor. Nilufar: Kelishdik — 20-mayda ishga tushiramiz. Reja bugun kechqurun tarqatiladi. Rahmat, hamma.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: uchta masala nima edi? Ikki: Jasur byudjet haqida nima dedi — besh, olti yoki yetti millionmi? Uch: yakuniy qaror qancha byudjet va qanday ko‘rib chiqish sanasi? To‘rt: nega muddat sakkiz emas, to‘qqiz hafta? Javoblarni ichingizda belgilang, keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what were the three items? Two: what did Jasur say about the budget? Three: what was agreed — how much and which review date? Four: why nine weeks, not eight? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: uchta masala nima edi? Ikki: Jasur byudjet haqida nima dedi? Uch: nima kelishildi — qancha va qaysi ko‘rib chiqish sanasiga? To‘rt: nega to‘qqiz hafta, sakkiz emas? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: uch masala — byudjet, muddat va rollar. Ikki: Jasur olti million dizaynga yetmaydi, yetti xavfsizroq dedi. Uch: kelishuv — olti million va yigirma ikkinchida ko‘rib chiqish. To‘rt: bayram tufayli muddat sakkizdan to‘qqiz haftaga siljiydi va ishga tushirish yigirma mayga belgilandi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: budget, timeline, roles. Two: Jasur argued six million would not cover design — seven was safer. Three: agreed — six million, review on the 22nd. Four: the holiday pushed the schedule from eight to nine weeks, launch on 20 May.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: byudjet, muddat, rollar. Ikki: Jasur olti million dizaynga yetmaydi, yetti xavfsizroq dedi. Uch: olti million, yigirma ikkinchida ko‘rib chiqish. To‘rt: bayram tufayli sakkiz hafta to‘qqiz haftaga siljidi — ishga tushirish 20-may.

scenes.title: AOB va yakunlash: 'Any other business?'

examples.t: Any other business? No? Let's wrap up here.

scenes.say_native: Agendaning oxirgi nuqtasi doim Any Other Business — kutilmagan qisqa masalalar uchun. Agar hech narsa bo‘lmasa: AOB? No? — keyin yakunlang: Let's wrap up here. Minnatdorchilik qisqa bo‘lsin: Thanks, everyone. Bir jumla murojaat bilan yoping: Minutes will follow today.
scenes.say: The agenda always ends with Any Other Business — room for small unexpected items. If none: Any other business? No? Then wrap up: Let's wrap up here. A short thanks, and one closing line — minutes will follow today, or the next meeting is Thursday.
scenes.say_uz: Agenda doim Any Other Business bilan tugaydi — kichik rejadan tashqari masalalar uchun. Bo‘lmasa: Any other business? No? Keyin yakunlang: Let's wrap up here. Qisqa rahmat va bitta yopilish jumlasi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy xulosa: 'So, to recap…'

examples.t: So, to recap: six million, nine weeks, roles assigned.
examples.uz: Xulosa: olti million, to‘qqiz hafta, rollar taqsimlandi.

scenes.say_native: Har yig‘ilish qaror bilan emas, qarorning xulosasi bilan yopiladi. 'So, to recap…' — keyin har qaror alohida: We've agreed that… The decision is… Eng oxirida: Any objections? Agar hech kim gapirmasa, qaror qonuniy. Jasur va Madina kabutar bo‘lsa, rozilik so‘rang: Jasur, are you happy with this?
scenes.say: Meetings close with a recap, not just a decision. 'So, to recap…' then each call separately: We've agreed that… The decision is… Final check: Any objections? Silence means consent. Doubtful voices get named: Jasur, are you happy with this?
scenes.say_uz: Yig‘ilish qaror bilan emas, qarorning xulosasi bilan yopiladi. 'So, to recap…' — keyin har qaror: We've agreed that… Final check: Any objections? Sukunat rozilik. Shubhalanganlarga: Jasur, are you happy with this?

scenes.title: Action items: kim, nima, qachon
scenes.say_native: Action item — uch element: mas’ul shaxs, aniq vazifa va muddat. Ismsiz 'we will send the draft' — muddatsiz, mas’ulsiz, bajarib bo‘lmaydigan. Minutes ichida action items alohida bo‘limda: kim — nima — qachon. Keyingi yig‘ilishning boshida shu ro‘yxat tekshiriladi — bu intizom yig‘ilishni ishlar yig‘ilishiga aylantiradi.
scenes.say: An action item has three parts: owner, task, deadline. 'We'll send the draft' has none. Write them as a list — who, what, when — inside the minutes. Next meeting opens by ticking them off; that discipline is what makes meetings produce work.
scenes.say_uz: Action item uch qism: mas’ul, vazifa, muddat. 'We'll send the draft' — uchalasiz. Ro‘yxat qiling — kim, nima, qachon — minutes ichida. Keyingi yig‘ilish shu ro‘yxatdan boshlanadi; shundagina yig‘ilish ish beradi.

scenes.title: Namuna: yig‘ilish bayoni (minutes)
scenes.say_native: Namuna bayonni o‘qing: sana va vaqt, qatnashuvchilar va uzrlar, har masala bo‘yicha qaror va action items. Bir sahifadan oshmasin. Hech qanday bahs-munozara yozilmaydi — faqat yakuniy qarorlar va vazifalar. Bayon yuborilgandan keyin o‘n besh daqiqa ichida kelgan izohlar qabul qilinadi.
scenes.say: Minutes — Payme app kick-off, 4 May, 10:00. Attendees: Nilufar, Jasur, Madina. Apologies: Timur. Budget: six million sums, reviewed on the 22nd. Timeline: nine weeks; launch 20 May. Roles: Madina — design; Jasur — backend; Nilufar — approvals. Action: Nilufar to circulate minutes today. Next review: 22 May.
scenes.say_uz: Bayon — Payme ilovasi kick-off, 4-may, 10:00. Qatnashchilar: Nilufar, Jasur, Madina. Uzrlar: Timur. Byudjet: olti million so‘m, yigirma ikkinchida ko‘rib chiqish. Muddat: to‘qqiz hafta; ishga tushirish 20-may. Rollar: Madina — dizayn; Jasur — backend; Nilufar — tasdiqlash. Vazifa: Nilufar bugun bayon tarqatadi. Keyingi ko‘rib chiqish: 22-may.

scenes.title: Xulosani aytib bering
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz xulosa qiling. Vaziyat: kick-off tugayapti — byudjet olti million, ishga tushirish yigirma may, dizayn Madinaga, backend Jasurga. 'So, to recap' bilan boshlang, har qarorni alohida qatorda ayting, action items ni ism va muddat bilan aytib, 'Any objections?' bilan yoping. Yigirma besh soniya.
scenes.say: Close the meeting aloud. Scenario: kick-off ends — budget six million, launch 20 May, Madina design, Jasur backend. Open with 'So, to recap', say each decision, then the actions with owners and dates, and finish with 'Any objections?' Twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Yig‘ilishni ovoz chiqarib yakunlang. Vaziyat: kick-off tugaydi — byudjet olti million, ishga tushirish 20-may, Madina dizayn, Jasur backend. 'So, to recap' bilan boshlang, har qarorni ayting, action items ni egalari bilan ayting, 'Any objections?' bilan yoping. Yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: namunaviy xulosa
board: 'So, to recap: six million, launch 20 May.'
'Actions: minutes today, budget signed by the 22nd.'
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: 'So, to recap — six million sums, launch on 20 May; Madina — design, Jasur — backend. Actions: minutes out today; budget signed by the 22nd. Any objections? Thanks, everyone.' To‘rt qator, o‘ttiz so‘z, hech qanday ortiqcha gap yo‘q. Shu shaklni yodlang — har yig‘ilishning oxirgi daqiqasi shu.
scenes.say: So, to recap — six million sums, launch on 20 May; Madina — design, Jasur — backend. Actions: minutes out today, budget signed off by the 22nd. Any objections? Thanks, everyone.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa — olti million so‘m, ishga tushirish 20-may; Madina — dizayn, Jasur — backend. Vazifalar: bayon bugun, byudjet yigirma ikkinchigacha imzolanadi. Kimdir norozimi? Rahmat, hamma.

scenes.title: Konsensus: 'I can live with that'

examples.t: I'd rather we cut the loyalty module. I can live with May.
examples.uz: Sadoqat modulini qisqartirsak yaxshi. Mayga rozi bo‘laman.

scenes.say_native: Konsensus — hamma 100 foiz xursand bo‘lishi shart emas, hech kim qat’iyan qarshi bo‘lmasligi kerak. 'I can live with that' — qabul qilaman, lekin jon o‘zimniki emassiz. 'I'd rather we…' — muqobil taklif. Norozilikka javob: muqobil, tan olish, kelishuv. Uzbek 'Men rozi bo‘laman' yoki 'Mayliga' diymiz — inglizchada 'I can live with that' aynan shu ma’noni beradi.
scenes.say: Consensus is not 100% joy — it is nobody's hard objection. 'I can live with that' — I accept it, not gladly but genuinely. 'I'd rather we…' — an alternative. Disagree by proposing: acknowledge, counter, agree. That is how professionals close.
scenes.say_uz: Konsensus — yuz foiz xursandchilik emas, hech kimning qat'iy qarshiligi yo‘qligi. 'I can live with that' — qabul qilaman, mamnuniyat bilan emas, lekin halol. 'I'd rather we…' — muqobil. Norozilik — muqobil taklif bilan: tan oling, javob bering, kelishing.

scenes.title: Namuna: kelishmovchilikni hal qilish
scenes.say_native: Namunada Jasur iyunga cho‘zishni taklif qiladi, Madina bayram savdosiga qarshi chiqadi, Jasur 'fair enough' bilan qabul qiladi va nilufar qarorni yozadi. E’tibor bering: hech kim yutqazmaydi — muammo faktga ko‘chadi va qaror barchaniki bo‘ladi. Shu uch qadam — ob’ektsiya, muqobil, kelishuv — eng kuchli yig‘ilish vositangiz.
scenes.say: Jasur: I'd rather we launch in June. Madina: I see it differently — June misses the holiday sales. Jasur: Fair enough. I can live with May, if marketing is ready. Nilufar: Agreed — 20 May. Any objections? Silence. Done.
scenes.say_uz: Jasur: Menimcha iyunga cho‘zsak yaxshi. Madina: Boshqacha qarayman — iyun bayram savdosini o‘tkazib yuboradi. Jasur: To‘g‘ri. Agar marketing tayyor bo‘lsa, mayga rozi bo‘laman. Nilufar: Kelishdik — 20-may. Kimdir norozimi? Sukunat. Qaror qabul qilindi.

scenes.title: Rozilik mashqi
scenes.say_native: Vaziyat: jamoangiz scope qisqartirishni xohlamaydi, siz esa muddatni xavfsiz qilishni istaysiz. 'I see it differently — but' bilan boshlang, o‘zingizning sababingizni bir raqam bilan ayting, keyin kompromis taklif qiling: review on the 22nd. Oxirida 'I can live with that' bilan roziligingizni bildiring. Yigirma soniya.
scenes.say: Practise disagreement aloud. Scenario: your team resists cutting scope; you want a safe deadline. Open with 'I see it differently — but', give one reason with a number, then offer the compromise — the 22nd review — and close with 'I can live with that.' Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Kelishmovchilikni ovoz chiqarib mashq qiling. Vaziyat: jamoa scope qisqartirishga qarshi; siz xavfsiz muddatni istaysiz. 'I see it differently — but' bilan boshlang, bir raqamli sabab ayting, kompromis taklif qiling — yigirma ikkinchi ko‘rib chiqish — va 'I can live with that' bilan yoping. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: rozilik shakllari
board: 'I see it differently — but the 22nd works.'
'I'd rather we keep it small and review early.'
'Fair enough — I can live with that.'
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: muqobilni hurmat qiling, o‘z sababingizni ayting, kompromisni taklif qiling, rozilik bildirib yoping. E’tibor bering — hech bir jumlada 'no' yoki 'wrong' yo‘q. Professional inglizchada norozilik doim muqobil shaklida keladi. Shu uch jumlani yodlang — ular har yig‘ilishda ishlaydi.
scenes.say: I see it differently — but the 22nd review works for me. I'd rather we keep scope small and check early. Fair enough — I can live with that.
scenes.say_uz: Men boshqacha qarayman — lekin yigirma ikkinchi ko‘rib chiqish men uchun mos. Menimcha hajmni kichik tutib, erta tekshiraylik. To‘g‘ri — bunga rozi bo‘laman.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: kechikish qaror yig‘ilishi
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — ombor kechikishi tufayli qaror yig‘ilishi. Ikki variant: ishga tushirishni cho‘zish yoki hajmni qisqartirish. Jasur cho‘zishni xohlaydi, Madina sadoqat modulini iyunga qoldirishni taklif qiladi. Tinglab, qaror va action items ni ajrating — savollar keyingi sahifada.
scenes.say: Nilufar: The warehouse delay changes our plan. Options: delay launch, or cut scope. Jasur: I'd rather we delay two weeks. Madina: I see it differently — cut the loyalty module, ship 15 May. Jasur: Fair enough. I can live with that. Nilufar: So, to recap: launch 15 May, loyalty module in June. Jasur — client note by Tuesday. Any objections? Good. Meeting closed.
scenes.say_uz: Nilufar: Ombor kechikishi rejamizni o‘zgartirdi. Variantlar: ishga tushirishni cho‘zish yoki hajmni qisqartirish. Jasur: Menimcha ikki hafta cho‘zsak yaxshi. Madina: Men boshqacha qarayman — sadoqat modulini tushirib tashlab, 15-mayda chiqamiz. Jasur: To‘g‘ri. Bunga rozi bo‘laman. Nilufar: Xulosa: 15-mayda ishga tushamiz, sadoqat moduli iyunda. Jasur — mijozga xabar seshanbagacha. Kimdir norozimi? Yaxshi. Yig‘ilish yopildi.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: kechikish sababi nima edi? Ikki: Jasur qaysi variantni taklif qildi — cho‘zishmi yoki qisqartirish? Uch: Madina nimani taklif qildi — qaysi modulni qoldirishni? To‘rt: Jasurga qaysi vazifa va qaysi muddat berildi? Javoblarni ichingizda belgilab qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what caused the delay? Two: which option did Jasur want? Three: what did Madina propose — which module and what date? Four: what action was given to Jasur and by when? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: kechikish sababi nima edi? Ikki: Jasur qaysi variantni xohladi? Uch: Madina nimani taklif qildi — qaysi modul va qaysi sana? To‘rt: Jasurga qaysi vazifa va qachongacha berildi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
board: 3. Sadoqat modulini iyunga qoldirish, 15-mayda ishga tushish
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: kechikish ombordan edi. Ikki: Jasur ishga tushirishni ikki haftaga cho‘zishni xohladi. Uch: Madina sadoqat modulini iyunga qoldirishni va 15-mayda ishga tushishni taklif qildi. To‘rt: Jasurga mijozga xabar yozish vazifasi seshanbagacha berildi va yig‘ilish to‘g‘ri Xulosa bilan yopildi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: a warehouse delay. Two: Jasur wanted to delay the launch by two weeks. Three: Madina proposed cutting the loyalty module to June and shipping on 15 May. Four: Jasur was given the client note by Tuesday; the meeting closed with a clean recap.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: ombor kechikishi. Ikki: Jasur ishga tushirishni ikki hafta cho‘zishni xohladi. Uch: Madina — sadoqat moduli iyunda, ishga tushish 15-may. To‘rt: Jasur mijozga xabarni seshanbagacha yozadi; yig‘ilish Xulosa bilan yopildi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: linking va weak forms
board: come in here — bitta oqim kabi
minute /maɪˈnjuːt/ — juda kichik; schedule BrE/AmE farqli

examples.t: Minutes in the minutes — two different words.
examples.uz: Minutes bir so‘z — ikki xil ma’no: bayon va soniya emas, daqiqa.

scenes.say_native: Inglizcha so‘zlashuvda yordamchi so‘zlar zaiflashadi: and /ənd/, of /əv/, to /tə/ — ularni to‘liq aytmang. Linking: come in here bir oqimday eshitiladi — come—in—here bir-biriga yopishadi. Minutes — bayon ham, daqiqalar ham /ˈmɪnɪts/; juda kichik degan so‘z minute /maɪˈnjuːt/ — boshqa so‘z. Schedule — Britaniyada 'shedyul', Amerikada 'skedjul' — ikkalasini tushunishingiz shart.
scenes.say: Function words go weak: and sounds /ənd/, of is /əv/, to is /tə/. Linking glues phrases: 'come in here' flows as one. 'Minutes' means the record and the time units — both /ˈmɪnɪts/. A tiny thing is 'minute' /maɪˈnjuːt/. And 'schedule': British 'SHED-yul', American 'SKED-jul'.
scenes.say_uz: Yordamchi so‘zlar zaiflashadi: and — /ənd/, of — /əv/, to — /tə/. Linking: 'come in here' bir oqimday eshitiladi. 'Minutes' — bayon ham, daqiqalar ham — /ˈmɪnɪts/; juda kichik narsa 'minute' /maɪˈnjuːt/. 'Schedule': britancha 'shedyul', amerikacha 'skedjul'.

scenes.title: O‘zbek so‘zlashuvchilar yig‘ilishi xatolari

examples.t: ✗ discuss about it  ✗ in this question  ✓ on this point
examples.uz: ✗ discuss about it  ✗ in this question  ✓ on this point

scenes.say_native: To‘rt xato. Bir: discuss about — xato; discuss to‘gridan-to‘g‘ri o‘tadi: discuss it. Ikki: o‘zbekcha 'bu savolda' → in this question emas — inglizchada on this point yoki on this issue. Uch: yet bilan present perfect: we haven't decided yet. To‘rt: buyruq ohangi — 'Please stop' — inglizchada faqat o‘ch, buyruq emas: muloyim ibora bilan to‘sib kiring.
scenes.say: Four fixes. One: 'discuss' takes no 'about' — discuss it. Two: not 'in this question' — 'on this point'. Three: 'yet' pairs with the present perfect — we haven't decided yet. Four: 'Please stop' sounds military — break in politely: 'Sorry, can I just say…'
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt tuzatish. Bir: discuss about — xato; discuss it dersiz. Ikki: in this question emas — on this point. Uch: yet — present perfect bilan: we haven't decided yet. To‘rt: 'Please stop' harbiy ohang — muloyim kirib kiring: 'Sorry, can I just say…'

scenes.title: Xatolarni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni tuzlang. Bir: 'Let's discuss about the budget' — about kerak emas. Ikki: 'In this question we disagree' — qaysi predlog kerak? Uch: 'We didn't decided yet' — qaysi zamon va qaysi shakl? Javoblarni ovoz chiqarib ayting, keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz. Yigirma besh soniya.
scenes.say: Fix three sentences aloud. One: 'Let's discuss about the budget'. Two: 'In this question we disagree'. Three: 'We didn't decided yet'. Twenty-five seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta gapni ovoz chiqarib tuzlang. Bir: 'Let's discuss about the budget'. Ikki: 'In this question we disagree'. Uch: 'We didn't decided yet'. Yigirma besh soniya.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tuzatilgan variantlar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: 'Let's discuss the budget' — about butunlay tushadi. Ikki: 'On this point we disagree' yoki 'On this issue, I disagree' — on predlogi. Uch: 'We haven't decided yet' — present perfect, haven't va uchinchi shakl decided. Bu uchta shakl yig‘ilish tilida eng ko‘p uchraydi — yodlang.
scenes.say: Answers. One: 'Let's discuss the budget' — drop 'about'. Two: 'On this point we disagree' — 'on', not 'in'. Three: 'We haven't decided yet' — present perfect with 'yet'. Three forms you will use daily in meetings.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: 'Let's discuss the budget' — about butunlay tushadi. Ikki: 'On this point we disagree' — on, in emas. Uch: 'We haven't decided yet' — yet bilan present perfect. Uchala shakl yig‘ilishda har kuni kerak.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: yig‘ilishni o‘tkazing
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy vazifa: o‘zingizni yig‘ilish rahbari deb tasavvur qiling. Beshta hamkasb, ikki masala — yangi mijoz va juma kungi demo. Oching, masalani ayting, bir hamkasb rozi emasligini tasavvur qilib, rozilikka keltiring — 'I see it differently', 'Fair enough' — va yig‘ilishni xulosa hamda action items bilan yoping. O‘ttiz soniya, ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Final task: you are the chair of a five-person meeting. Two items — new client onboarding and Friday's demo. Open it, walk the agenda, handle one disagreement politely, then close with a recap and actions. Thirty seconds, aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy vazifa: siz besh kishilik yig‘ilish rahbarisiz. Ikki masala — yangi mijoz qo‘shish va juma kungi demo. Oching, agendani o‘ting, bir kelishmovchilikni muloyim hal qiling, keyin Xulosa va action items bilan yoping. O‘ttiz soniya, ovoz chiqarib.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
board: Minutes bir sahifa, qarorlar alohida qatorda
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Agenda oldindan yuboriladi va vaqt chegaralari bilan ishlaydi. Fikr — ramka, sabab va savolga qo‘shilish. Muloyim to‘sib kirish — uzr belgisi va bitta aniq sabab. Xulosa — 'So, to recap', qarorlar alohida qatorda, action items kim-nima-qachon formatida. Bayon bir sahifa — bahs yo‘q, faqat qarorlar.
scenes.say: Sum up. The agenda goes out early, time-boxed. Opinions carry a frame, a reason and a question back. Breaking in is an apology marker plus one reason. Closing is 'So, to recap' with decisions and who-what-when actions. Minutes: one page, decisions only.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilamiz. Agenda oldindan yuboriladi, vaqt chegaralari bilan. Fikr — ramka, sabab, qaytaruvchi savol. To‘sib kirish — uzr belgisi va bitta sabab. Yopilish — 'So, to recap', qarorlar va kim-nima-qachon vazifalar. Bayon — bir sahifa, faqat qarorlar.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘n daqiqalik haqiqiy yoki xayoliy yig‘ilishning bayonini yozing — sana, qatnashchilar, uzrlar, qarorlar va action items har biri kim-nima-qachon formatida; bir sahifadan oshmasin. Keyin uni ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Keyingi darsda taqdimot qilishni o‘rganamiz — signposting, vizuallar va savollarga javob. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: minutes for a ten-minute real or imagined meeting — date, attendees, apologies, decisions, and action items in who-what-when form; one page maximum. Read it aloud. Next lesson: giving a presentation — signposting, visuals and handling questions. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: o‘n daqiqalik haqiqiy yoki xayoliy yig‘ilishning bayoni — sana, qatnashchilar, uzrlar, qarorlar va action items kim-nima-qachon formatida; bir sahifa. Ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Keyingi dars: taqdimot — signposting, vizuallar va savollar. Omad tilayman!

quiz.q: What is the main purpose of an agenda?
options: To keep the meeting structured and on track
quiz.why_uz: Agenda yig‘ilishni tartibli va maqsadga muvofiq qiladi — masalalar raqamli va vaqt chegarasi bilan.

options: Good morning, everyone. Let's make a start.
quiz.why_uz: Professional ochilish: salom + minnatdorchilik + 'Let's make a start' — 45 soniyada ishga o‘tish.

quiz.q: Which phrase politely gives an opinion?
options: From my perspective, we should cut scope.
quiz.why_uz: 'From my perspective' — fikrni ramkaga soladi va tajribaga tayangan, ingliz muhitida eng xavfsiz kuchli ramka.

quiz.q: How do you interrupt a speaker politely?
options: 'Can I come in here for a second?'
quiz.why_uz: Uzr belgisi + ruxsat so‘rash + qisqa sabab — 'Can I come in here?' eng muloyim kirish shakli.

quiz.q: What does 'Let's take this offline' mean?
options: Discuss this later, outside the meeting
quiz.why_uz: Offline — bu muhokamani yig‘ilishdan tashqariga, ikki kishilik suhbatga ko‘chirish: yig‘ilish cho‘zilmaydi.

options: The written record of the meeting
The agenda of the next meeting
quiz.why_uz: Minutes — yig‘ilish bayoni: sana, qatnashchilar, qarorlar va action items — bir sahifalik yozma xulosa.

quiz.q: A complete action item must include…
quiz.why_uz: Kim — nima — qachon: uchchala elementsiz vazifa bajarib bo‘lmaydi va keyingi yig‘ilishda tekshirib bo‘lmaydi.

quiz.q: What does the chair achieve with 'Any objections?'
quiz.why_uz: 'Any objections?' — oxirgi tekshiruv: sukunat rozilik sanaladi; e’tiroz bo‘lsa, qayd etiladi va qayta ko‘rib chiqiladi.
Discuss — 'about'siz o‘tadi; 'on this point' deyiladi; yet — present perfect bilan; buyruq emas, muloyim ibora ishlatiladi.

options: At the very start of the meeting
At the end of the agenda, before wrapping up
quiz.why_uz: AOB — agendaning oxirgi nuqtasi: rejadan tashqari kichik masalalar va yopilishdan oldin oxirgi imkoniyat.
